description: Senior reviewer finds scroll bug and accessibility issue with deep reasoning. Strong senior performance.

prContext.title: Add virtual scroll list
prContext.description: Virtualized list for large candidate tables.

groundTruth.description: Position absolute without relative parent — items are positioned relative to the nearest positioned ancestor, which may not be the scroll container. Causes items to render in wrong locations. The inner div should be position: relative.
No overscan — items at the edge of the viewport appear blank while scrolling fast. Should render 2-3 items above and below the visible range.
onScroll updates state every scroll event — high-frequency scroll events cause excessive React re-renders. Should throttle or use requestAnimationFrame.
No aria attributes — screen readers see only the visible items and lose context of total list size. Should add aria-setsize and aria-posinset.

reviewer_comments.what: Position absolute needs a positioned parent. Items will render in wrong locations.
reviewer_comments.why: Without position: relative on the inner div, absolute positioning is relative to the viewport or nearest positioned ancestor.

reviewer_comments.what: No overscan — blank gaps while scrolling fast.
reviewer_comments.why: Need 2-3 buffer rows above and below the viewport for smooth scrolling.

reviewer_comments.what: onScroll updates state on every event — too many re-renders.
reviewer_comments.why: Should throttle or use rAF to batch scroll updates.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Three blocking issues: layout, overscan, and scroll performance.

implementer_responses.updated_code: const overscan = 3; const visibleItems = items.slice(Math.max(0, startIndex - overscan), endIndex + overscan);

verdict.summary: All three fixes verified. Layout, overscan, and throttling look correct.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 3 of 4 bugs (layout, overscan, throttle). Missed aria attributes. Level 4-5.

prioritization.rationale: All three flagged as blocking. Level 4-5.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Verified all three fixes. Layout and overscan changes are correct. Level 4-5.
